title: Add read-only D87 decision backtest command with fixture tests
summary: Add a read-only Rust backtest: typed headers for D87 and D88 only, a parser for the supersession phrases in docs/decisions.md, and code that reads records/ and runs one exact-match signal. Agent copies lack records/, so this job delivers the command and tests on small fixture records. The real run, introspection record and findings report come after landing.

defaults_applied.how: All new code and tests are Rust.
Unit tests for the header, the parser, the record reader and the signal on fixtures; cargo test passes and clippy is clean.
One command covering only D87 and D88; no Jev, brief or gateway change.
The verifier runs the command with cargo run against the fixtures.
Module docs and the command help are written for an outside reader.
The signal is exact-match and is not tuned; a fail is reported as a finding.
Use existing workspace crates (serde, clap) rather than new parsing libraries.

assumptions: The command is a new athena-cli subcommand (clap) with its logic in a library module, probably athena-data or athena-cli, chosen by where record readers already live.
Fixture records are small files under a test fixtures directory; they are not copies of real records.
The parser runs against the real docs/decisions.md in tests, since that file is present in agent copies; the D46->D79 and D87->D88 hits are asserted there.
The introspection record is written by the command only when the signal matches; no model call is made in this change, so the record's language-model drafting step is out of scope.
No new dependencies unless a crate already in the workspace lacks what is needed.

acceptance_criteria.text: A typed header exists for D87 and D88 only, with kind, scope, status, enforcement, assumptions and signals. D87's enforcement is not code-check, and D87 is marked amended_by D88.

Run cargo test. It passes, including a test that the supersession parser over docs/decisions.md returns the D46->D79 and D87->D88 hits plus the Amends entries, matched case-insensitively, with no entry lacking a target id.
Run cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo fmt --check. Both are clean.

Fixture tests show that over fixture records with at least 2 distinct jobs having matching hand-change interventions, the signal marks D87 under-review and cites the job ids and intervention ids. Over a fixture with 1 job, or with an unrelated decision, it marks nothing. D88 is never marked.

Run the command with cargo run against the fixture records directory. It prints the D87-era landing and intervention ids found and the single signal's verdict. The code makes no agent, model or gateway call, and it reads records/ only.

The command is read-only apart from an introspection record written when the signal matches. Its decisions_matched field holds D87, and the code checks that every earlier_cases id exists and is in the same class.

The change does not edit docs/decisions.md, defaults.toml, any brief, athena.toml or other governance files, or any Jev or gateway code. The real run over records/, the real introspection record and the findings report are stated as out of this change.

out_of_scope: Running the backtest over the real records/ directory
The real introspection record and the findings report, which come after landing
Jev, brief, defaults.toml and docs/decisions.md changes
Typed headers for decisions other than D87 and D88
New record kinds other than the typed header and the introspection record
departures: Cost and time sit above the reference: the change spans a parser, a record reader, a signal and a CLI command with fixtures, and I did not read the record formats.
